judgments.reason: The transcript and model text state the winner 'pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives a three-coin auction commission.' There is no example or claim showing bids above available coins winning due to commission being applied before payment.

The rules and play record state sealed rival bids remain private and the focal player never used waiting to observe committed rival bids before committing; no mechanism showing waiting reveals sealed bids is articulated or demonstrated.

The specification requires 'close' only after all lots are sold; the focal player closed after all three lots were resolved. There is no observed early settlement or evidence that close can settle with unauctioned lots.

The model explicitly states 'catalog items are not auction wins' and the three-coin commission is described as awarded to auction winners; there is no evidence or articulation that catalog purchases receive that commission.
